description: This file implements the Device Firmware Update (DFU) protocol logic for a bootloader, including handling commands such as get list, device ID, read, write, erase, and jump to application. It manages communication with external tools or hosts over a custom protocol, interfacing with flash memory and system control registers.

methods.name: getMcuRevision
methods.description: Returns the microcontroller revision ID by masking the DBGMCU IDCODE register.

methods.name: getByte
methods.description: Reads a byte from the communication channel with a timeout.

methods.name: sendByte
methods.description: Sends a single byte over the communication channel.

methods.name: dfuCalcChecksum
methods.description: Calculates XOR checksum over a buffer of specified size.

methods.name: isBootloaderAddress
methods.description: Checks if an address falls within the bootloader flash region.

methods.name: isInVirtualPageBuffer
methods.description: Checks if an address points within the in-memory virtual buffer for the bootloader.

methods.name: readAddress
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit address and checksum, validates it, and returns the address or virtual buffer address.

methods.name: complementByte
methods.description: Returns the bitwise complement of a byte.

methods.name: bufToInt16
methods.description: Converts a 2-byte buffer into a 16-bit integer.

methods.name: prepareInterruptsForJump
methods.description: Prepares system interrupts and vectors for jumping from the bootloader to the main application.

methods.name: dfuJumpToApp
methods.description: Jumps execution to the specified application address, performing necessary system preparations.

methods.name: dfuHandleGetList
methods.description: Handles the DFU command to retrieve available commands.

methods.name: dfuHandleDeviceId
methods.description: Handles the DFU command to retrieve the MCU device ID and revision.

methods.name: dfuHandleGo
methods.description: Handles the DFU command to jump to a specified application address.

methods.name: dfuHandleRead
methods.description: Handles the DFU command to read data from flash or the virtual buffer and send it to the host.

methods.name: dfuHandleWrite
methods.description: Handles the DFU command to write data to flash or the virtual buffer.

methods.name: dfuHandleErase
methods.description: Handles the DFU command to erase specified flash sectors.

methods.name: dfuStartLoop
methods.description: Main loop that processes incoming DFU commands and executes corresponding handlers.

methods.name: getTsChannel
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the communication channel object.
